name: 写作
description: Collins Writing for IELTS 全 12 单元。覆盖 Task 1 图表作文（柱状图/折线图/表格/流程图/地图/混合图）与 Task 2 议论文（Problem-Solution / Stance / Agree-Disagree / Evaluate an idea）全部题型技巧，配语法专项（时态/比较级/被动语态/情态动词/冠词/衔接与cohesion）。

examInfo.time: 60 分钟（Task 1 约 20 分钟 + Task 2 约 40 分钟）
examInfo.total: 2 篇作文（Task 1 ≥150 词 + Task 2 ≥250 词）
examInfo.note: Task 2 分值占比高于 Task 1

sections.desc: 图表描述（≥150词）：柱状图/折线图/表格/流程图/地图/混合图
议论文（≥250词）：Problem-Solution / Stance / Agree-Disagree / Evaluate an idea

units.title: Gender roles
units.topic: Task 1 图表作文结构分析；Task 2 Problem-Solution（问题-解决方案）

examInfo.title: Exam information: Writing solutions to problems
points: Task 2 要求写 四到六个段落（four to six paragraphs）的议论文。
题目会要求你 evaluate or present an idea or solution to a problem。
目标是 present a strong argument, supported by evidence。
答题时间约 40 minutes；字数 ≥250 words。
必须 give reasons and include relevant examples。

examTips: Task 1：不要描述图表中的 所有信息。目的是测试你 summarise the key information 和 select appropriate examples 的能力。
Task 2 分值高于 Task 1，应花更多时间写 Task 2。

techniques.name: Task 1 概述与主体段结构
techniques.detail: Introduction 说明图表主题 + 概括；Body 段按 topic sentence + supporting examples 组织；Conclusion 概述整体趋势。

examples.en: The chart shows the gender distribution of students doing scientific research across a range of disciplines at a UK university in 2019.
examples.cn: 概述句：图表展示2019年英国某大学各学科学生的性别分布

examples.en: Male students made up a large proportion of the student group in subjects related to the study of objects and materials: physics, astronomy, and geology.
examples.cn: 主体段1 topic sentence：男性在研究物体/材料的学科中占大比例

examples.en: Overall, the chart shows that at this university there were differences in the type of scientific research undertaken by male and female students.

techniques.name: 倍数与比较表达
techniques.detail: 描述图表中的倍数关系与数量比较。

examples.en: there were five times as many male students as female students
there were twice as many female research students as male research students
examples.cn: 女性研究生是男性的2倍

examples.en: Women students outnumbered male students in subjects related to the study of living things
examples.cn: 女性在研究生物的学科中数量超过男性

grammar: 一般现在时（描述图表事实）
比较级：significantly more women than men
倍数表达：five times as many, twice as many
过去时（2019年数据）
让步结构：In spite of the many advances, ...
connectors: Overall / In general / In brief / To conclude（结论与概述）
In fact / In particular / Moreover / Furthermore（补充强调）
With regard to / In terms of（方面限定）
This was also true of...（相似性）
exercises: Task 1 sample answer 段落功能标注（Introduction / Body / Conclusion）
Task 2 范文段落功能标注（example / summary / better solution / acknowledgement / advantage）

units.title: Diet and nutrition
units.topic: Task 1 Line graph；Task 2 Taking a stance（立场型议论文）
questionTypes: Task 1: Line graph (two or more graphs)
Task 2: Taking a stance / Discuss both views

examInfo.title: Exam information: Presenting your opinion
points: 先决定你的 stance（立场），再用 reasons / evidence 支持。
通过比较 至少一个对立观点 来 'test' your opinion。
观点强度标记：SA = Strongly agree, A = Agree, D = Disagree, SD = Strongly disagree。

examTips: 如果图表包含 两个或以上的图，概述应说明它们之间的 connection——趋势是 broadly similar or different。
用 templates for common question types 练习生成观点：Templates A/B = solutions to problems；Templates C/D = discussing ideas。

techniques.name: 折线图描述句型
techniques.detail: 每段约50词；段落1用 there be + adjective + noun；段落2用 verb + adverb。

examples.en: The number of people experiencing food insecurity rose steadily from 2010 to 2015 and then fell slightly.
examples.cn: there be + adj + noun 句型

examples.en: Levels of very low food security have fluctuated considerably over the period.
The two graphs show broadly similar trends.

techniques.name: 立场型议论文结构
techniques.detail: 先定 stance → 给 evidence → 比较对立观点 → 结论中承认对方观点。

examples.en: Although some people idealise traditional cooking practices and believe them will prevail indefinitely, demographic trends suggest that this is unlikely to be the case.
examples.cn: 让步+立场：承认传统烹饪观点，但用人口趋势反驳

examples.en: The first reason is... / Another reason... is...
examples.cn: 段首 signal word 标志论点

examples.en: In the UK, for example, working mothers significantly outnumber stay-at-home mothers.

grammar: 情态动词表可能性：could lead to, may very well, is likely to, it is unlikely
让步从句：Although + 句子, 主句
条件表达：It is better for the environment to produce food using fewer chemicals
Task 1 句型：there be + adj + noun；verb + adverb
connectors: 让步对比：Although, Nevertheless, In spite of, While, By contrast, On the other hand
因果：Because of, Due to, As a result, Consequently, Therefore
顺序/补充：The first reason is, Another reason, In addition, Moreover, Furthermore
立场表达：In my view, From my point of view, I believe that...
趋势动词：rose, fell, fluctuated, peaked, climbed, dropped, levelled off, remained stable
exercises: 观点强度排序练习（SA/A/D/SD）
Reasons 库选理由支撑观点
Type D 'Evaluate an idea' 范文结构分析

units.title: Educational goals
units.topic: Task 1 Bar chart；Task 2 To what extent do you agree…
questionTypes: Task 2: To what extent do you agree/disagree
examTips: 用 adverbs 使比较更精确：强调差异用 many, much, far, significantly；小差异用 slightly or nearly as ... as。
柱状图描述用 in contrast 表差异，the same 表相似。
Task 2：定立场后决定 哪些想法入选、什么顺序，有 plan 写作更快更聚焦。
watchOuts: fewer / fewest 搭配可数名词，less / least 搭配不可数名词。

techniques.name: 柱状图比较与改写
techniques.detail: 用相似/差异表达描述数据；练习用不同词替换改写句子。

examples.en: More female candidates than male candidates passed their English examinations.
Fewer male candidates passed than female candidates.
The number of males was as high as the number of females.
Men did well in technology-related subjects, whereas women did well in language-related subjects.

techniques.name: Notes 三栏法 + Essay plan
techniques.detail: What are the ideas? / Evidence for? / Evidence against? 三栏笔记法组织论点。

examples.en: Idea: Exams measure intelligence | Evidence for: Exams can be designed to include a variety of tasks | Evidence against: Pen and paper exams are often predictable – students can prepare by rote learning
Introduction: Measuring intelligence is a difficult task → Body 1: Exams measure intelligence (for/against) → Body 2: Different types of intelligence

grammar: 比较级与比较结构：higher/lower than, as...as, nearly as...as, more...than
最高级：the largest percentage, the lowest
修饰比较级的副词：significantly more, slightly higher
fewer/fewest（可数）vs less/least（不可数）
被动语态：degrees awarded were second class or better
定语从句：people who do well in exams
connectors: 差异/相似：in contrast, by contrast, whereas, the same, similarly, likewise
因果：because, since, as, due to, so
让步：although, though, while, even though
程度：to a large extent, to some extent, largely, by and large
总结：In brief, Overall, To sum up, In conclusion
exercises: S/D 标注练习（similarity vs difference）
用括号词改写句子（fewer / as...as / whereas / lower / similar）
Notes 三栏法填写（ideas / evidence for / evidence against）
Essay plan 提纲写作

units.title: Biodiversity
units.topic: Task 1 Process diagram（流程图）+ Map（地图）
examTips: 合并句子使流程描述更可读：Combine sentences with the same subject by removing repeated subjects and linking with commas and 'and'。
当动作主体未知或不如动作本身重要时，使用 passive voice。
用 signposting language 标记流程阶段：Firstly, In the final stage 等。开头一个、中间一两个、末尾一个即可。

techniques.name: 流程图：主动 vs 被动判断
techniques.detail: 自然过程用 active；有人类施动者的过程用 passive。

examples.en: The first plants to grow are pioneer plants, which can survive in harsh conditions.
examples.cn: 自然过程→主动+关系从句合并

examples.en: The logs are sorted by size, loaded onto logging trucks and transported to the sawmill.
examples.cn: 人类过程→被动+逗号and合并

examples.en: Firstly, access roads to the area are cut. In the final stage of clear cutting, the land is prepared for future harvests.

techniques.name: 地图描述：变化动词
techniques.detail: 区分 removed / replaced / shrank / built / flooded / reduced 等不同变化动词；被动语态改写。

examples.en: The maps show changes that have taken place on the island between 1970 and 2019.
Large areas of native forest were removed and partially replaced with palm oil plantations.
The area of intact forest in the west shrank.

grammar: 主动 vs 被动语态（核心）：自然过程→主动；人类行为→被动
现在完成时被动：The trees have been extracted
关系从句合并：pioneer plants, which can survive...
被动+分词短语：loaded onto logging trucks and transported to the sawmill
不定式目的状语：to mark the stages of the process
connectors: 流程顺序：Firstly, Then, Next, Subsequently, After that, In the final stage, Finally
因果/结果：as a result, consequently, so that, therefore, thus
转折：However, Whereas, Although
补充列举：and, as well as, in addition
地图变化动词：increased, decreased, remained stable, expanded, shrank, was replaced by, was flooded
exercises: 流程图句子合并练习（6题）
主动/被动判断练习
地图范文被动语态改写
signposting language 填空

units.title: Global English
units.topic: Task 1 Mixed（表格+图表）；Introductions and conclusions
watchOuts: 不要照抄题目指令的原话。用自己的话改写能展示更多语言能力。

techniques.name: 概述句（Introduction）四选一判断
techniques.detail: 最佳 introduction 含总体特征/对比，不堆细节；具体数字适合作 body。

examples.en: The diagram shows that although many languages are spoken throughout the world, the size of their respective speech communities varies enormously.

The diagram shows that a very small number of languages (approximately 100) hold a dominant position, whereas more than half of the world's languages are spoken by a very small percentage of the world population (0.2%).

techniques.name: Introduction vs Conclusion 写法
techniques.detail: Introduction：改写题目、给出总体视角；Conclusion：In summary... 概括，不给新数据。

examples.en: In terms of rank order, English was by far the most commonly studied second language, followed by French, Spanish, German and Russian.
examples.cn: Main paragraph 按 rank order 组织

examples.en: English also experienced the most significant growth over the two decades, rising from 60 percent to 80 percent.
In summary, ...

grammar: 时态：图表事实用一般现在时；已完成对比用一般过去时
百分数表达：rising from 60 percent to 80 percent, just under 20 percent
比较级/最高级：by far the most commonly studied, the most significant growth
分词短语作状语：most notably between 2000 and 2010
关系从句：those who..., the percentage of which...
connectors: 顺序/位置：In terms of rank order, first, second, finally, by far, followed by
变化：rising from...to..., growing, gaining in popularity, nearly trebled, experienced growth
对比：on the other hand, by contrast, whereas, while
总结：In summary, Overall, To sum up, In conclusion, In brief
时间：over the two decades, between 2000 and 2010, over the 20-year period
exercises: 概述句四选一判断练习
Introduction vs Conclusion 句式判断
Main paragraph 按 rank order 组织写作

units.title: The Internet
units.topic: Task 1 Table；Task 2 Planning an essay（大纲写作）
questionTypes: Task 2: To what extent does… / Discuss both sides

examInfo.title: Exam information: Organising essays
points: Task 2 essays 可以用不同方式组织。某些组织模式能让你 show more skills in language and argumentation。

examTips: Look for patterns in the data 给描述一个结构：把 similar items together 分组，找 associated trends。
watchOuts: 不要试图包含 所有数字。聚焦 summarising the key information，每条 general observation 配 一两个例子。

techniques.name: 表格描述四步法
techniques.detail: 看末行→总体结论；看第一列→按类别分组；看第三列→最大/最小占比；看末列→与其他列建立关联。

examples.en: The table shows that over the ten-year period there was an exponential increase in Internet use worldwide.
The number of Internet users expanded more than tenfold, with the proportion of the world's population online reaching fifty-seven percent in 2020.

techniques.name: Essay outline（提纲）结构
techniques.detail: Introduction → Body 1（Idea in the question + Evidence for）→ Body 2（Other possible idea + Evidence for）→ Conclusion。

examples.en: Idea in the question: Internet can increase social isolation → young people who spend a lot of time online cannot develop social skills or make real friends
Other possible idea: Internet can bring people closer together → people who cannot go out easily can keep in touch with friends online
The Internet can bring people together if used in the right way.

grammar: 现在完成时（至今累计增长）：There has been an exponential increase in…
过去时与现在完成时对比
不定式作目的状语：to develop social skills
关系从句：people who spend a lot of time online
动名词作主语/宾语：Reading emails, Using social networking
百分比与倍数：more than tenfold, 57 percent
connectors: 转折对比：however, but, on the other hand, whereas, while, by contrast
因果：because, since, so, as a result, therefore
举例：for example, e.g., such as
补充：in addition, moreover, furthermore
让步：although, even though, despite
因果目的：so that, in order to, which allows people to...
exercises: 表格四步法分析练习
三条 general statements + supporting details 写作
Essay outline 提纲评价（strengths and weaknesses）

units.title: Consumer spending
units.topic: Task 1 Mixed task（Line graph + Table）；因果关系谨慎表达
examTips: 引言应说明 两个图表之间的关系（link）。
用以下表达 谨慎表述因果关系：when...rises,...also appear to...；the more...the more...；when...falls,...appear to...；the less...the more...

techniques.name: Mixed task 引言与主体段
techniques.detail: Introduction 说明两个图各展示什么 + 它们的关系；主体段按年龄组分组描述。

examples.en: The line graph shows average disposable income for three age groups from 2000 to 2020. The table gives the percentage increase in sales for seven products at five-year intervals. Seen together, the figures suggest a link between age, disposable income and sales.
Sales of products typically enjoyed by young people, trainers, mobile phones, and skateboards, showed a similar pattern with sales growing strongly between 2000 and 2004.
Overall, the figures suggest that the sales performance of different types of products may be influenced by disposable income available to different sectors of the population.

techniques.name: 谨慎因果表达句型
techniques.detail: 用 appear to / tend to / may be influenced by 等避免绝对化。

examples.en: when disposable income rises, sales also appear to rise
the more disposable income people have, the more they spend on luxury goods
may be influenced by disposable income

grammar: 过去时 + 完成时：2000–2020 历史数据用过去时；区间累计用现在完成时
定语从句：products typically enjoyed by young people
被动语态：is influenced by disposable income
比较结构：more than, the most, as...as
谨慎情态：appear to, tend to, may, might, suggest
connectors: 谨慎因果：appear to, tend to, seem to, may be influenced by, suggest that, is associated with, correlate with
相关结构：the more...the more..., the less...the more..., when...rises,...also appear to...
转折/对比：whereas, while, by contrast, on the other hand, similar pattern
时间/顺序：from 2000 to 2020, between 2000 and 2004, over the period, thereafter
结果：so that, thus, hence, as a result
exercises: Mixed task 引言写作（三句信息）
因果关系图组描述练习
Table 描述框架填空（Introduction / Body / Conclusion）

units.title: Children and parents
units.topic: Task 1 支撑细节信号词；Task 2 情态动词的恰当使用

examInfo.title: Modal verbs 功能分类
points: will = making a promise or prediction（承诺或预测）
must = indicating strong obligation or necessity（强烈义务）
can = making a suggestion / indicating ability（建议/能力）
should = tentatively making a suggestion（试探性建议）

examTips: Task 1：最常见的支撑细节信号词是 for example，也可用其他表达。
Task 2：can, should, might 等情态动词帮助框定观点，常用于表示 intention, obligation, permission, ability, possibility。

techniques.name: 支撑细节信号词四类
techniques.detail: superlatives / expressions indicating example / focusing expressions / expressions indicating uniqueness。

examples.en: the biggest difference
for example / for instance / such as
especially / in particular / particularly
the only / the sole / the most common

techniques.name: 情态动词在议论文中的运用
techniques.detail: 范文用 must/should/can/could/will 分别表义务/建议/能力/后果/预测。

examples.en: society must bear some of this responsibility
government could ensure that its policies take the interests of children into account
local government and charities can ensure that young people have access to independent confidential sources of help
It would be wrong to say that…

grammar: 情态动词表义务/建议/可能：must（强烈义务）、should（试探性建议）、can/could（可能/能力/建议）、will（承诺/预测）、might/may（较低可能性）
情态动词 + 被动：can be done, could be done, should be cut
关系从句：children who do not have the same access to power
动名词/不定式：the means to defend their rights
让步从句 + 介词短语：because children do not have…
connectors: 顺序标志：Firstly, Secondly, A third possible measure, Finally
补充：In addition, Moreover, Furthermore
让步转折：However, Nevertheless, Although, While
因果目的：so that, in order to, therefore, thus
举例：for example, such as, for instance
总结：In short, In conclusion, To sum up, Overall
exercises: 信号词分类练习（superlatives / example / focusing / uniqueness）
段落填空（with the exception of / the most common / the clearest）
情态动词功能配对（will/could/must/can/should）
范文结构分析（Introduction → Body 1-3 → Conclusion）

units.title: An ageing population
units.topic: Task 1 段落精简（removing unnecessary words）；Task 2 Creating cohesion with summary words
examTips: 用 moreover 强调额外要点；用 although / however 表示对比。
Cohesion 常由 this / these 维持：summary word 指代 前一句的核心要点，如 *The gap in life expectancy has grown. This trend is likely to continue.*
通过 重复关键词 维持衔接（link back to exam question or thesis statement）；其他需重复的词用 synonyms。

techniques.name: 段落精简：删除多余 cohesive devices
techniques.detail: 删除多余的 in fact, Moreover, In addition, Also, however；拆分过长复合句；修正逗号粘连。

examples.en: The age group with the highest percentage of both men and women is 55 to 59, roughly five percent of the population.
Until the age of 59, the proportion of males and females is roughly equal. Thereafter, women make up a higher proportion of the elderly population.
examples.cn: 拆分过长句（修正逗号粘连）

techniques.name: Summary words 创造衔接
techniques.detail: 用 this trend / this development / these issues 等总结词指代前文要点。

examples.en: The changes that result from allowing men into female-dominated occupations may be subtle, but they are far-reaching. However, to benefit the most from this development, it is important not to expect males and females to approach work in identical ways.
examples.cn: this development 指代前文 changes

examples.en: A number of measures should be taken to address these issues.
examples.cn: these issues 指代前文 drawbacks

examples.en: To some extent, therefore, this trend may be inevitable.
examples.cn: this trend 指代前文 languages disappearing

vocab: invest properly in the health services
grammar: 强调句：It is true that...
现在完成时：have disappeared, has grown
被动语态
不定式作目的/主语：to ensure that..., to spend a longer proportion...
动名词作主语：Saving sufficient sums of money would ensure...
并列/从属连词与标点规范（逗号粘连、run-on sentence）
connectors: 补充强调：moreover, in addition, also, what is more
对比：although, however, whereas, on the other hand, by contrast
因果：therefore, so, thus, as a result, due to
总结指代：this trend, this development, this alone, these issues, this view
顺序：Firstly, In addition, Another measure that should be taken
总结：In short, Overall, To sum up
exercises: 段落精简练习（删除多余词、拆分复杂句、修正标点）
Summary words 填空（development / issues / initiative / trend）
Repetition 训练：识别被重复的关键词及其同义替换

units.title: Fame
units.topic: Task 1 Formal language + Synonyms；Task 2 Choosing the right level of formality

examInfo.title: Exam information: General v specialist knowledge
points: Task 2 题目通常要求讨论 general rather than specialist knowledge 的问题。
因此 IELTS Writing Task 2 所需语言 often predictable。

examTips: Task 1 中避免重复同一词很有挑战——学习 synonyms for common expressions。

techniques.name: 正式语体替换
techniques.detail: 将非正式表达替换为正式书面语。

examples.en: really big changes → significant changes
Lots of → Many / A large number of
E.g. → For example
Amazingly → Notably / Remarkably
didn't even show up → failed to appear / feature

techniques.name: 同义词替换库（10个常用表达）
techniques.detail: 掌握核心词的同义词以避免重复。

examples.en: advantage → benefit / merit
disadvantage → drawback / downside
opinion → view / standpoint
however → nevertheless / on the other hand
people → individuals / respondents / the public
problem → issue / difficulty / challenge
important → significant / crucial

grammar: 数量表达：A similar number/percentage, nearly one in five, only four percent
非正式 vs 正式语体：缩略（aren't, wasn't）、口语化（big, lots of, show up）→ 书面表达
同义替换（避免重复）：professions → occupations/jobs; respondents → participants
关系从句：which were not included in the 1990 list
现在完成时：have increased, has risen
connectors: 顺序：On the whole, At the other end of the scale, In short
补充/转折：On the contrary, On the other hand, However, Furthermore, In addition
举例/引用：for example, for instance, such as
因果：so, therefore, as a result
比较/程度：A similar number/percentage, particularly, relatively high, nearly one in five
exercises: 正式语体替换练习（6个非正式表达→正式）
同义词替换练习（professions / respondents / appeared）
表格描述同义替换写作
Task 2 同义词库构建（10个核心词）

units.title: Transportation
units.topic: Task 1 Articles（冠词）；Task 2 Correcting errors in sentence structure
examTips: 常见错误是 article a and the 的误用。遵循 some basic guidelines 可避免大多数错误。
检查你之前写过的文章，列出 most common mistakes，检查时注意它们。

techniques.name: 冠词规则（a/an/the）
techniques.detail: 单个可数名词泛指用 a；序数词/最高级/一类人/唯一性词用 the。

examples.en: a car, a student
examples.cn: 泛指单数可数名词→用 a

examples.en: the second, the first
the biggest
the educated, the poor, the wealthy
the sole, the only
Cars can be seen as status symbols.
examples.cn: 可数名词泛指→复数不加冠词

techniques.name: 十大常见句法错误识别与纠正
techniques.detail: 主谓一致/冠词/可数不可数/介词/词类/关系从句/动词形式/时态/流水句/残句。

examples.en: The evidences show → The evidence shows
is most important safety measure → is the most important safety measure
It is illegally to drive → It is illegal to drive
depends of several factors → depends on several factors
can to provide → can provide
Many people which living → Many people who live

grammar: 冠词规则（核心）：a（泛指单数）/ the（序数词、最高级、一类人、唯一性）
可数 vs 不可数：evidence（不可数）/ evidences（错）
主谓一致、介词（depend on）、词类（illegal vs illegally）
关系从句（who live vs which living）
动词形式（can provide vs can to provide）
时态（has declined last year→declined last year）
流水句（用分号/连词）、残句（补全）
connectors: 因果结果链：as a result, as a consequence, consequently, therefore, hence, so
原因：because, since, as, due to
转折对比：however, on the other hand, whereas, by contrast
相关表达：inversely proportional to, outweigh, correlate negatively with
总结：In short, Overall, To sum up
exercises: 冠词填空练习（10空）
十大句法错误识别与纠正（10句）
连接句子练习（linking words: as a result / because / as a consequence / since）

techniques.name: Task 2 范文批注要点
techniques.detail: Type D 评价性议论文：承认对立观点→'tested' idea；段首 signal word；每段配具体例子；结论中 acknowledging opposing view。

examples.en: Although some people idealise traditional cooking practices and believe them will prevail indefinitely, demographic trends suggest that this is unlikely to be the case.
examples.cn: 让步+立场：承认对方观点→已'tested' idea

examples.en: The first reason is the decline in family size... Another reason convenience foods are likely to become more popular is the increase in the number of adults who work in full-time employment.
examples.cn: 段首 signal word 标志论点

examples.en: In the UK, for example, working mothers significantly outnumber stay-at-home mothers.
convenience foods are likely to continue to grow in popularity and may very well eventually replace traditional methods
examples.cn: 结论：预测表达 + 承认对立观点

techniques.name: Task 1 范文批注要点
techniques.detail: 一般现在时描述图表；一般过去时描述特定年份数据；最高级比较多项；比较级比较两项；结论概括不给理由。

examples.en: The bar chart shows the percentage of home and international students in the UK achieving at least a second class degree in eight subjects in 2018.
examples.cn: 一般现在时描述图表内容

examples.en: the largest percentage of good passes was in Art History and Sociology (80%). The lowest was in Information Technology (55%).
four out of five degrees awarded to students from abroad were second class or better (versus fewer than two out of three for home students)
examples.cn: 比较级比较两组学生 + 数量表达多样化

examples.en: In brief, the chart shows that home students tended to do better in Arts and Social Science related subjects, whereas international students tended to do better in technology related subjects.
examples.cn: 结论：概括要点，不给理由

grammar: 时态：图表当前内容用 simple present；特定年份（2018）数据用 simple past
数量表达多样化：over half of, the largest percentage, four out of five, fewer than two out of three, roughly 70%
最高级（>2项比较）：the largest percentage, the lowest
比较级（2项比较）：higher than, lower than
让步状语从句前置：Although + 句子, 主句
情态动词表预测：may very well, is likely to
不定式/动名词：devote himself/herself to, spend (time) doing, tend to do
connectors: 让步对比：Although, In fact, However, On the other hand, Whereas, While
因果：because, due to, since, so, therefore, as a result
举例：for example, for instance, such as
顺序/补充：In addition, Moreover, Furthermore, What is more
预测表达：likely to, unlikely, expected to, may well, it is likely that
结论总结：In brief, In summary, Overall, To sum up, In conclusion
